I wrote the review to `.social-review.md`. X and Bluesky fail, and LinkedIn passes.

- **X — FAIL:** it is 310 characters against the 255 limit. The suggested fix drops the last sentence ("Rule five is the one most teams skip…"), which brings it to 206.
- **LinkedIn — PASS:** no hard-rule breaks. I skipped the advisory suggestions pass and didn't launch the critique sub-agents; I checked the rubric rules myself.
- **Bluesky — FAIL:** the blog URL is in the post body, but the link is added automatically. The suggested fix removes the URL and leaves the rest as is, at 181 characters.

I checked both repaired versions with `len()` and they are under their limits. The file follows the format in `SKILL.md`, so it starts with the `<!-- social-review -->` marker and ends with the commit footer. I did not post a PR comment.
